messages:
maria.lopez: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — consolidated the remediation list and runbook gaps into a short sweep. We need owners, due dates, and a tiny triage playbook patch for future occurrences. Reply with what you can own.
kevin_h: I can own the cache eviction alert tuning (INC-4826). ETA: EOD Tue. Will post a PR with thresholds.
aj: I’ll take the canary rollout guardrails and the rollback doc. Need someone to sanity-check the rollback script (little busy today).
priya_sre: I will update the triage runbook steps and add the exact commands we used last night. Planning a PR with snippets and a short test checklist by Thu.
samuel_pm: I’ll draft the customer comms snippet and incident summary template to add to the playbook. Expect a draft tomorrow.
oncall-bot: Reminder created: task INC-4826 assigned to kevin_h, due 2026-03-31.
maria.lopez: Nice — two quick asks: 1) Put the PR link in this thread when open. 2) For the runbook change, include a short annotated example of the exact failure signature to watch for (so L1s can triage).
kevin_h: PR opened: https://git.company/r/inference-alerts/pulls/44 — tuning + smoke test added. cc @priya_sre for runbook cross-check.
priya_sre: Reviewed Kevin's PR, looks good. I'm adding a small section in runbooks/evictions.md with this snippet:
```bash
# quick check for high prefix evictions
kubectl -n rw-inference exec -it $(kubectl -n rw-inference get pod -l app=inference -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- 
  curl -s localhost:9000/metrics | grep kv_cache_evictions
```
Also adding an automated alert query and a remediation step to runbook.
aj: Rollback script draft in https://git.company/r/deploy-scripts/pulls/9, ping me for a quick review window. I added a safety gate: abort if >2 nodes report GPU oom.
samuel_pm: Added the customer comms snippet to the playbook PR: https://git.company/r/incident-playbook/pulls/12 — short, clear, no technical jargon.
maria.lopez: Great. Action items summary: 
- Cache alert tuning & smoke test — owner: kevin_h — due: EOD Tue — PR #44
- Runbook triage and commands — owner: priya_sre — due: Thu — PR pending
- Canary rollout & rollback script — owner: aj — due: Fri — PR #9
- Customer comms template — owner: samuel_pm — due: Tomorrow — PR #12
Please ack and add if I missed anything. I’ll create a short sprint ticket to track these as a single sweep.
kevin_h: ack :thumbsup:
priya_sre: ack. Also adding a short test to verify KV prefix cache stability in the staging job pipeline.
aj: ack, will ping for review slot.
oncall-bot: Sprint ticket created: SWEEP-227 (runbook + remediations follow-up) — linked tasks: INC-4826, PRs #44 #9 #12.
maria.lopez: Thanks team — check back here with PR links and I’ll close the sweep ticket once everything is merged.
